info.title: starter
info.description:
Authenticate with the access token that `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Successful responses wrap their payload in `data`. Every error carries a machine-readable `code` and a `message` for display, except `422`, which lists the invalid fields.

Messages follow the `Accept-Language` header: `en-US` or `pt-BR`, falling back to `en-US`.

patch.description:
Changes the locale, the time zone, or both. A field left out keeps its value. Returns the
updated user.

put.description:
`attachmentId` is an image the user uploaded through `POST /attachments`: jpg, jpeg, png or
webp, at most 2 MB. Send `null` to remove the avatar. Returns the updated user.

422.description: The attachment is unknown, another user's upload, or not accepted here; Unprocessable Entity

post.description:
Send the file as `multipart/form-data` in the `file` field, up to 20 MB, with an
accepted file extension. Returns the attachment with a signed URL valid for 1 hour.
Pass its id to an endpoint that takes an attachment, such as the avatar. An attachment
that nothing uses after a day is deleted.

413.description: The request body is larger than 20 MB

get.description:
Returns the tenants the signed-in user is a member of, suspended ones included, sorted
by name. Send a tenant's id in the X-Tenant-Id header to act inside it.

post.description:
The signed-in user becomes its first member and holds an Owner role with every
permission, named in the request's language.

get.description:
Newest first. The whole trail requires `audit.view`. Filtering by `subjectType` also lets in
the permission of the feature that owns that subject: `roles.manage` for `role`, and
`members.manage` for `member` and `invitation`. `type` keeps only the listed event types, and
`from` and `to` bound the creation date, both inclusive.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's account activity
get.description:
Events on the signed-in user's account outside any tenant, newest first: the ones they
performed, such as sign-ins and profile changes, and the ones performed on their account, such
as a platform admin disabling it.

get.summary: Show the signed-in user's admin access
get.description:
Any signed-in user may call it. `platformAdmin` tells the frontend whether to show the admin
area. `twoFactorRequired` is true for a platform admin who has not confirmed two-factor
authentication: every other admin route refuses them until they do.

Requires `platform.admin`. Lists every tenant on the platform, ordered by name, with its
member count. `search` matches part of the name, ignoring case.

get.summary: Show a tenant and its members
get.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. Each member comes with their role name in the tenant (null when
they hold none) and whether they are a platform admin.

put.description: Requires `platform.admin`. Records an audit event on the tenant's trail.

post.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. Members of a suspended tenant get `403` on every tenant route.
Suspending a tenant that is already suspended keeps its first suspension date. Records an
audit event.

get.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. Lists every user on the platform, ordered by email, with their
tenant count and whether they are a platform admin. `search` matches part of the email or
full name, ignoring case.

post.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. Signs the user out everywhere and blocks their sign-in. Disabling
a user who is already disabled keeps their first disable date. Records an audit event.

Requires `platform.admin`. Answers like sign-in, with the user and an access token that
expires after one hour. The frontend uses this token in place of the admin's and keeps the
admin's token to switch back. Records an audit event.

409.description: The user is a platform admin; The user is disabled

delete.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. For a user who lost their device. Turns off two-factor
authentication, signs the user out everywhere, and emails them a password reset link: they
cannot sign in until they choose a new password. Not idempotent: a repeat answers `409`
because two-factor is no longer enabled. Records an audit event.

409.description: The user is a platform admin; The user is disabled; Two-factor authentication is off

post.summary: Grant platform admin access to a user
post.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. The user gets `platform.admin` in every tenant, and must confirm
two-factor authentication before they can use the admin area. Records an audit event.

delete.summary: Revoke a user's platform admin access
delete.description:
Requires `platform.admin`. Admins cannot revoke their own access, so at least one platform
admin always remains. Records an audit event.

get.summary: Check that the API is running
get.description: Answers `200` as long as the process can serve requests. Checks no dependencies.

get.summary: Check that the API and its services are ready
get.description:
Send the monitoring secret in the `X-Monitoring-Secret` header. Runs every health check
(database, Redis, storage, disk and memory) and returns the report: `200` when all pass,
`503` with the same report when any fails.

401.description: The X-Monitoring-Secret header is missing or wrong

post.description:
Returns the new user and an access token, so the caller is signed in right away. Mails a link
to verify the email address, valid for 24 hours. Without `locale`, the account takes the
request's Accept-Language locale.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Returns the user and an access token to send as a bearer token. When the account has two-factor
authentication on, it returns `twoFactorRequired: true` and a `challenge` instead: send it with
a code to `POST /auth/login/two-factor` within 5 minutes.

Wrong passwords for one email from one IP are limited to 5 per 15 minutes, then blocked for 15
minutes.

400.description: The email or password is wrong

403.description: The account is disabled; The account must reset its password through the emailed link

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.summary: Finish signing in with a two-factor code
post.description:
The second step of a login that answered with a `challenge`: send it with either a code from
the authenticator app or one recovery code. Returns the user and an access token. A recovery
code works once. When the challenge fails, sign in again with the password.

Wrong codes for one user are limited to 5 per 15 minutes, then blocked for 15 minutes.

400.description: The two-factor challenge is invalid or expired; The code or recovery code is wrong or already used

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.description:
Mails a reset link when the email belongs to an enabled account. The answer is the same either
way, so it does not tell whether an account exists. The link expires after 1 hour, and a new
request replaces it.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.summary: Reset the password with an emailed token
post.description:
Takes the token from the emailed reset link. Each token works once. Signs the user out of every
session, so they sign in again with the new password. Also marks the email as verified.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.description: Takes the token from the emailed verification link. Each token works once.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.summary: Sign out of the current session
post.description: Revokes the access token that made the request.

get.description:
The signed-in user's sessions, most recently used first, with the device each was opened on.
`current` marks the session making the request. Sessions an admin opened to act as the user are
not listed.

delete.description:
Signs the user out everywhere except the session making the request. `revoked` is how many
sessions were signed out.
Signs that session out. It can be the current one.

post.description:
Mails a new link to the signed-in user, valid for 24 hours, and invalidates the previous one.
Does nothing when the email is already verified, and still answers with success.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

get.description:
`recoveryCodesLeft` counts the unused recovery codes, and is 0 while two-factor authentication
is off.

post.description:
Starts, or restarts, enrollment. Returns the secret to show as a QR code (`uri`) and for manual
entry (`secret`). Calling it again replaces the pending secret. Nothing changes about signing
in until `POST /account/two-factor/confirmation` confirms it with a code.

delete.description:
Needs the password and either a code from the authenticator app or one recovery code. Deletes
the secret and every recovery code.

400.description: The password is wrong; The code or recovery code is wrong or already used

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.description:
Confirms the pending secret with the password and a code from the authenticator app. Returns
the recovery codes, the only time they are shown. Signs the user out of every other session.

400.description: The password is wrong; The code or recovery code is wrong or already used

409.description: Two-factor authentication is already on; Two-factor enrollment was not started

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

post.description:
Needs the password and a code from the authenticator app. Replaces every recovery code, used or
not, and returns the new ones, the only time they are shown.

400.description: The password is wrong; The code or recovery code is wrong or already used

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

get.description:
Returns the permission keys the signed-in user holds in the tenant, for the frontend to
show or hide its UI. The server still checks each permission on every request.

403.description: The tenant is unknown, or the user is not a member of it; The tenant is suspended

get.description:
Any member of the tenant may call it. Returns every permission a role or a member can
hold, grouped by area, for rendering role and permission editors.

403.description: The tenant is unknown, or the user is not a member of it; The tenant is suspended

get.description:
Requires `roles.manage` or `members.manage`, so a members manager can pick a role when
inviting or assigning. Sorted by name.

post.description: Requires `roles.manage`. Role names are unique in the tenant.

put.description: Requires `roles.manage`. Replaces the role's name and its whole permission list.

delete.description:
Requires `roles.manage`. A role still assigned to a member cannot be deleted: assign
those members another role first.

get.description:
Requires `members.manage`. Returns each member's profile, role id and individual
permissions, sorted by name, or by email when the name is empty.

put.description:
Requires `members.manage`. Replaces the member's role; a null `roleId` leaves them
without one. Their individual permissions are kept.

404.description: The user is not a member of the tenant; Not Found

put.description:
Requires `members.manage`. The member's individual permissions become exactly the given
list; an empty list removes them all. Permissions from their role are not affected.

get.description:
Requires `members.manage`. Returns the invitations not yet accepted or revoked, newest
first. Expired ones are included: compare `expiresAt` with the current time.

post.description:
Requires `members.manage`. Emails the invitation link, valid for 7 days. Inviting an
email that already has a pending invitation replaces it: the old link stops working
and the role and expiry are reset.

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

delete.description: Requires `members.manage`. The invitation link stops working.

post.description:
Joins the tenant named by the invitation with its role, and marks the user's email as
verified. The invitation must have been sent to the signed-in user's email. Accepting
an invitation to a tenant the user already belongs to only uses it up. Returns the
tenant; send its id in the X-Tenant-Id header of later requests.

404.description: The invitation is unknown, already used, or expired; The user is not a member of the tenant; Not Found

429.description: Too many attempts; retry after the Retry-After header

field.description: The field path where the error occurred (dot notation)

rule.description: The name of the validation rule that failed

index.description: The array index if this error is for an array element

meta.description: Additional metadata about the error (e.g., attempted value, rule options)

AlreadyMemberException.description: The email already belongs to a member of the tenant

CannotRevokeSelfException.description: The caller tried to revoke their own access

ImpersonatingException.description: The session is an admin acting as the user

InvalidResetTokenException.description: The reset token is invalid, expired, or already used

InvalidTenantHeaderException.description: The X-Tenant-Id header is missing or not a UUID

InvalidVerificationTokenException.description: The verification token is invalid, expired, or already used

InvitationEmailMismatchException.description: The invitation was sent to a different email

LastManagerException.description: The change would leave no one able to manage members

MemberNotFoundException.description: The user is not a member of the tenant

PlatformAdminProtectedException.description: The user is a platform admin

RoleInUseException.description: The role is still assigned to a member

SessionNotFoundException.description: No active session of the user has this id

tenant.name: X-Tenant-Id
tenant.description: The id of a tenant the signed-in user is a member of.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign up, sign in, and recover access to an account.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in user's profile, avatar, email verification, and activity.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: The signed-in user's access tokens, one per device.

tags.name: Two-factor
tags.description: Time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) and recovery codes for the signed-in user.

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: File uploads that other records reference by id.

tags.name: Tenants
tags.description: The workspaces the signed-in user belongs to.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: What a member may do in a tenant. Every operation here runs inside the tenant named by the `X-Tenant-Id` header.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Named sets of permissions in a tenant. Every operation here runs inside the tenant named by the `X-Tenant-Id` header.

tags.name: Members
tags.description: The users of a tenant. Every operation here runs inside the tenant named by the `X-Tenant-Id` header.

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invitations to join a tenant by email. Every operation here runs inside the tenant named by the `X-Tenant-Id` header. Accepting an invitation is the exception: the tenant comes from the invitation.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Who changed what in a tenant, and when. Every operation here runs inside the tenant named by the `X-Tenant-Id` header.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: The platform admin area, across every tenant and user. A platform admin must have two-factor authentication confirmed to use it.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for orchestrators and monitoring.
